name: FutureTech II Acquisition Corp. Unit
summary: FutureTech II Acquisition Corp. currently possesses no substantial business operations. Its primary objective is to finalize a business combination, which may involve a merger, capital stock exchange, asset acquisition, stock purchase, or restructuring with one or more enterprises. The company intends to direct its acquisition efforts toward firms within the technology industry. Established in 2021, its corporate headquarters are located in New Rochelle, New York.
